interpretation: Keep the event within the new budget and dates without touching what is already confirmed.

options.title: Drop the live band and the favours
options.rationale: A playlist through the venue's sound system keeps the evening lively, and favours are the easiest extra to let go.
assumptions: The venue has a sound system you can use.

options.title: Simpler decoration and no outfit budget
options.rationale: Let the venue's own setting carry the look, and wear outfits you already have.

newTask.title: Ask the venue what decoration is included

assumptions: The venue includes basic table decoration.

options.title: A smaller venue
options.rationale: A hall with a lower hire fee frees the most money in one step.
assumptions: A smaller hall can still seat everyone.
Confirmed costs stay exactly as agreed.
